question: Should agents.defaults.mediaMaxMb become a hard pre-provider limit for locally materialized video and music references, matching image_generate despite changing existing permissive behavior?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but only maintainers can confirm that the existing global media setting was intended to reject these generation inputs during upgrades and that direct hosted video URLs may remain exempt.

options.title: Adopt unified cap semantics
options.body: Land the patch and treat the configured media limit as authoritative for locally loaded generation references across all three generation tools.

options.title: Preserve permissive references
options.body: Pause or close the PR and retain the current behavior until a separately approved input-limit contract or opt-in policy is designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt unified cap semantics
recommendation.body: Land the patch and treat the configured media limit as authoritative for locally loaded generation references across all three generation tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The history indicates this person introduced both built-in generation tools and is best positioned to confirm their shared configuration contract.
